_about: DAY TRACK paper log (docs/day-track-spec.md). One row per trading day the track was evaluated: the trade the run COULD have taken at the quote it actually saw, managed against the bars. Rows share the shape of holdings.json._DAY_TRACK.results plus phase:'paper'. Written by the first run at/after 09:35 ET; exits appended by later runs. Read by day_track.graduate() at the Monday calibration.

rows.decided_by: scheduled run 13:30Z 2026-09-15 (unattended, prompt v10) -- first post-bell run, DAY TRACK paper day 1

opening_range.source: get_equity_historicals(QQQ, interval='minute', bounds='regular') 13:30-13:34Z, all five bars present and settled by 13:35:10Z. ONE-MINUTE bars per spec, never 5-minute buckets.

exit.triggered_on: VEHICLE first, signal one minute later -- both confirm, see r_note
exit.evidence: QQQ 1-minute bars (bounds=regular): 13:37 high 708.730 (stop 708.855 NOT breached), 13:38 high 709.100 -> BREACHED; spot 709.010 at 13:45:59Z venue time, 0.155 above the stop and never reclaimed below it. PSQ 1-minute bars: 13:37 low 26.1600 <= psq_stop 26.1671 -> BREACHED one minute EARLIER; PSQ 26.150 at 13:45:47Z venue time. Both instruments agree the trade is stopped; they disagree only on the minute, which is the finding this run recorded.
exit.r_note: RECORDED AT THE STOP PRICE PER SPEC ('later runs ... record exits at the stop / chop / flat prices'), which is -1.00R by construction. THE HONEST FILL IS WORSE AND IS NOT BEING HIDDEN: a resting stop_market on PSQ triggers and then fills AT MARKET, and PSQ's next tick down is 26.16, so the realistic fill is 26.16 -> -$1.96 -> -1.254R. The spec's convention is kept so graduate() reads one consistent statistic across the paper sample and this run does not get to change the track's statistic; the slippage figure is carried here and flagged to the Monday calibration.
exit.day_complete: YES. Spec: 'One day trade per trading day. Stop hit = done for the day.' No re-entry on 2026-09-15 regardless of what QQQ does next.

rows.capital_note: Paper only -- no order placed, none placeable: _DAY_TRACK.status is PAPER and LIVE additionally requires the v11 stamp, while this run was invoked with v10. Sizing used deployable $1,470.86 (unleveraged_buying_power $1,664.60 minus the 5% operational reserve $193.74). NOTE THE COLLISION AND THAT IT IS UNRESOLVED IN THE SPEC: $1,470.92 of that same cash is under the LIVE _cash_hold for the 2026-09-16 FOMC. _DAY_TRACK.capital_priority says the day trade claims deployable cash at its entry run, and a day-track position is flat by 15:30 ET the same session so it never spans the catalyst the hold is waiting on -- but the two rules have not been read against each other by anyone with authority to settle it. In PAPER this costs nothing. BEFORE THE TRACK GOES LIVE Ryan should say which claim wins; see holdings.json._DAY_TRACK_VS_CASH_HOLD_UNSETTLED_2026-09-15.
rows.quote_provenance: Both venue timestamps are at/after 13:35Z, i.e. OUTSIDE the opening auction window, so this row satisfies the standing re-quote rule. The 13:31-13:33Z quotes taken earlier in the run were NOT used for it.
rows.bugs_found_and_fixed_by_this_row: Two, both in day_track.plan_entry, both caught only because this was the first SHORT signal the track ever produced. See holdings.json._DAY_TRACK_SHORT_SIDE_SIZED_IN_THE_WRONG_INSTRUMENT_2026-09-15.
